You make out a fridge. You make out an oven. You can see a table. What a coincidence, weren't you just thinking about a table? The table is massive. But the thing hasn't got anything on it.   yellow potato

  roast the pork chop
  chop the yellow potato
  roast the yellow potato
  prepare meal
